Name: Em's Tree Seed Birds Custom Tree Compatibility Patch
Author: HarrisonGrey
Description:
Hi, I'm Harry. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41939]Em's Tree Seed Birds[/url] was a collaboration between me and Em. If you've got a mod that adds custom Wild Trees, we wanted to make available a small compatibility template for adding your trees to the functionality of the Wild Bird Feeder. The file here is a single .json, simply look for YourTree, YourTree_SeedItem, and YourTreeSeedEntry and replace with the appropriate data from your mod.

Once it has the proper data, you can either add this file into your mod and Include it like this:
[code]    {
      "Action": "Include",
      "FromFile": "assets/YourTreeSeedBirdsTEMPLATE.json",
      "When": { "HasMod": "RivalRabbit.EmsTreeSeedBirds" }
    },
[/code]﻿Or simply copy and paste the two data entries in this file into your contents.json or another included .json.

You will also want to add "RivalRabbit.EmsTreeSeedBirds" as an optional dependency in your Manifest so that the Wild Bird Feeder loads first and your mod can add information to it.

Feel free to change the "Condition" on YourTreeSeedEntry, but it does need to include a RANDOM below 1 or else nothing past your entry will show up in the feeder. Also, note that your entry gets moved before "WildSeeds"; this is very important as WildSeeds should always be the last entry in the list, nothing listed after it will show up.

Have fun!

Downloads.Description: A compatibility template so your custom wild trees can work with the Wild Bird Feeder
